_doc: Validation bands for the share of a civilisation's people living in towns at its start date (Complaints/reports/research-urban-share.md section 3). The simulator's computed share must fall inside its band; the band is a check, never an input. A civilisation with no band has no source found. `threshold` names what counts as a town, since sources differ.

rome_100ad.source: Scheidel 2007, as quoted in Hanson and Ortman 2017, JRA 30 (the empire-wide 10 to 15 per cent was not found in the opened text; a lead, not a verified figure)

england_1300.source: Britnell, up to about 15 per cent in towns, via the Cambridge Urban History conclusion (search summary, not opened); all Europe under 5 per cent in 1300 for towns over 10,000, de Vries via Clark chapter 4 (opened)

norse_900ad.source: Helle, Cambridge History of Scandinavia, chapter summary: barely over 0.5 per cent in the Viking Age, about 3 per cent at the end of the high Middle Ages (search summary, not opened)
